dogecoin.text:
Personally, I believe if #dogecoin ever hits $1, it's price will snowball even higher because it's demand will be so high from people wanting to catch "the next bitcoin" wave. 

Those people would be wise to hop aboard while it's still cheap, though. :)

Seeing a lot of people that think #dogecoin is dying because of it's current dip. I would just like to remind those people that, since Jan. 1st, 4 months ago, Dogecoin is up almost 4,000% and since this time last year, it's up 17,000%. Stay strong. Keep buying more. It's worth it
